item.title: How Surfing Humbles Us
item.description: Surfing is a funny thing. One session, we can feel like we have the ocean dialed. The next, like we'd never paddled in salt water. Yes, surfing humbles us.

item.title: Body of Missing Woman Seen in Mouth of Shark, Says Witness
item.description: The search continues for a woman who went missing from a California beach this week. Eyewitnesses say they saw the woman's body in the mouth of a shark.

item.title: Mullaghmore Was Truly Massive on December 18th
item.description: Mullaghmore is an absolutely terrifying wave.The largest swell in half a decade rolled into the Irish coastline on December 18, and it got BIG.

item.title: Black Diamond Pool in Yellowstone Erupts in Spectacularly Muddy Fashion
item.description: The Black Diamond Pool in Yellowstone National Park is an interesting place. It is a pretty active spot, and on Saturday morning it had the zoomies.

item.title: 10 Great White Shark Encounters From 2025 That Are Truly Amazing
item.description: Every year, Carlos Gauna spends untold hours flying his drone over the ocean in search of great white sharks. He drummed up a Top 10 list for the shark fans.

item.title: The 2025 Rockstar Energy Open Was a Big Hit in Breckenridge
item.description: The 2025 Rockstar Energy Open in Breckenridge brought back a competition format unique to snowboarding, and athletes are already calling for more.

item.title: REI’s Campwell Down Parka Is the Definition of Winter Bang for Buck
item.description: The REI Co-op Campwell Down Parka is a winter heavyweight that costs half as much as similar options on the market. We put it to the test to see if it stands up to what it claims to be.

item.title: Old Is New: Carissa Moore Wins Pipe Pro, John John Florence Runner-Up
item.description: Carissa Moore made another statement this week, winning the Pipe Pro. John John Florence also had a strong showing after his year off, finishing second.

item.title: Julian Wilson Is Forgoing a Championship Tour Return, Will Instead Focus on Building His Brand
item.description: It appears Julian Wilson is ending his attempt to claw back onto surfing's Championship Tour after two poor results on the Challenger Series.

item.title: Chairlift Collision Leaves Skier Trapped as Husband Plunges 230 Feet to Death
item.description: This week, a horrific chairlift accident in Montenegro left one man dead, his wife seriously injured and multiple skiers trapped on a lift.
